blocks.text: User feedback ka matlab hai digital content behtar banane ke liye users ki raaye jama karna:

items: Surveys and Forms: Digital content par raaye lene ke liye surveys istemal karein aur zaroori behtari karein. Misal: Website banane ke baad users se poochein ke un ka tajurba kaisa raha, aur un ke mashwaron ke mutabiq tabdeeliyan karein.

Direct Communication (seedhi baat cheet): Users se seedha rabta karein ta ke un ki zaroorat aur pasand samajh sakein. Misal: Apni presentation par class fellows ki raaye lein aur us ki madad se presentation ko zyada mo'assar (effective) banayein.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Kitab ke mutabiq 2020 mein Pakistan ne Personal Data Protection Bill pesh kiya, jis ka maqsad shehriyon ke data aur un ki privacy ki hifazat hai. Is bill ke mutabiq idaron ko personal data jama karne se pehle wazeh (explicit) consent (ijazat) leni hogi aur aise data ko mehfooz tareeqe se store karna hoga. (Bill qanoon ka masauda hota hai; is ki maujooda haisiyat check kar lein.)

blocks.prompt: Content accessible banane ke baad bhi users se feedback kyun lein?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke asal users, maazoor afraad samait, woh mushkilat batate hain jo banane wale ko nazar nahi aati; un ke mashwaron se content mazeed behtar hota hai.

items: User feedback: surveys and forms (website ke baad raaye), direct communication (presentation par class fellows ki raaye).
Personal Data Protection Bill (2020): data jama karne se pehle wazeh consent aur mehfooz storage.
